claims.text: The incident channel abandoned no cache theory: the channel's final root cause was a retry configuration mismatch with the timeout budget causing a backlog of duplicate requests, while the webhook backlog came from an exhausted worker pool, not DNS resolution. No evidence addresses a cache theory in the incident channel.

supports.quote: Final root cause: retry configuration mismatched the timeout budget, causing a backlog of duplicate requests.
The webhook backlog came from an exhausted worker pool, not DNS resolution.

claims.text: An engineer who is not in the incident channel may not inspect its old discussion: removal from a source channel prevents future citation and history access, and previously saved copies cannot be recalled. Partner users may read approved integration eligibility guidance only, as incident details are not public guidance.

supports.quote: Removal from a source channel prevents future citation and history access; previously saved copies cannot be recalled.
